Allowance is prorated by active days: 'If a Starter registry is active for 16 days in a month, it receives ~285 MiB of storage allowance'.

egress.terms: No egress charge is stated for DOCR anywhere on the pricing or limits page; DOCR is described as 'a private Docker image registry', so there is no public/anonymous pull path and no CDN-facing egress at all.

tooling: doctl registry, docker. Private only — pulls require a DO API token.
chaining: 1 registry, 1 repository, 500 MiB. Not worth chaining; a second account buys 500 MiB more.
limits_note: 1 registry, 1 repository, 500 MiB prorated; 100 GB max image, 20 GB max per layer; untagged images count toward quota; storage overage 'Not Available' on Starter (hard stop).
reliability_note: Starter's prorated storage means a fresh registry can be charged overage on a partial month; 500 MiB is below any useful dataset.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
